Before arriving, I received an email from the hotel's concierge, offering assistance with airport transportation and other arrival details. I have to say that the concierges at Mr. C's are among the best I've ever interacted with. Not only are they very corteous and professional, but they are well connected, experienced and effective. They fond the perfect solutions every time, from renting a Fiat 500 to getting me on the guest list of a popular night spot. A big recognition to Solomon in the concierge desk!
The valets and doormen are equally effective and very elegantly appointed in non-ostentatious but classic Barbour jackets.
The hotel lobby takes you straight into the main bar, where I was treated to fantastic bellinis. So good that I went up to my room after 45 minutes of arriving!
The bar and lobby scene is relaxed, refined and dressed up in an Italian/bauhaus design mix, with the friendliest bar servers that you can imagine. There is an outdoors terrace on the bar, which is perfect for an ever more intimate experience.
The hotel's reception is cleverly hidden behind the bar, so that at no moment do yo feel in a hotel. I always felt as if arriving to a friend's apartment. Very cozy and welcoming!
I used the hotel's gym several times and it is very well equipped with cardio and weights although it is on the smaller side and I could see it crowding up on peak seasons.
The hotel's pool is next to the restaurant! which makes the entrance a bit intimidatng at lunch time, however, it is ver cutely arranged and I would really like to come back in the summer heat to dip in and enjoy more bellinis there.
My room had a striking view to Beverly Hills and Hollywood. I slept with the drapes open as it was impossible not to fall in love with the sight. Very quiet day and night, although I can imagine that rooms facing the city side on West Pico Ave. must be noisier. The rooms are all very elegantly decorated in a matching blend of French riviera, sea-side villa and Italian country side. You experience wood, leather, pastels and rich fabrics. Very complete mini-bar (including intimacy and healing kits!), iPod compatible stereo, flat screen on-demand TV with movies and very fast and free wi-fi everywhere. My room had a small terrace that I used for breakfast and after work drinks. Fantastic!! I could live here!!
The restaurant was the best part of my stay. Although not as popular as I would have expected for a Cipriani property, the service, quality and value are truly remarkable. I felt as if dining in a high end place in Rome. Truly, something else! from the proseco to the slow roasted chicken, I very much enjoyed breakfast, lunch and dinner at Mr. C.
All in all, Mr. C's is an excellent representation of a luxury boutique hotel. It is discreet, elegant and powerful. Just what I like!
I will surely be back!

“Your own Don Draper meets Hollywood experience....” ...at least thats the vibe they are going for.
The rooms were good sized, very clean, comfortable, and fun . My wife loved the vanity. Very comfortable, large bed, good sitting area. Lots of little details and all in all came together. We initially had a city view room, but relaly all we could see was the stripmall across the way. We asked to be moved and got upgrade to a Hollywood / Beverly Hills view room - much better. On a clear night or day you can see all of the hills, etc... this is where you wanna be. Great view and amazing having breakfast on the deck. 
The hotel was overall a fun and great experience. It definitely is pricey in all aspects. And service is good if not a bit over the top trying at times. 
But definitely recommend for a fun weekend for romance or group getaway.

“Fabulous hotel and restaurant” We have stayed here twice now and each time has been absolutely flawless. I LOVE the fact that the rooms have wood flooring as opposed to dirty carpet. Very clean, comfortable and well appointed rooms. Love the trunk style furniture. Have not had any issues with traffic noise. The fact that you can text to have your car brought up is basically genius in my book. When you check in it feels like they know you. The restaurant serves some of the best Italian food I have every had. Thank you Mr C for coming to the LA area! This is our go to whenever we have to be in Los Angeles.

“Exceptional service” My partner and I went to LA on business for two nights. To our surprise, we felt like we'd taken a vacation to Venice or Rome. The moment you step off your car, the service, style and vibe of this place is European. Extraordinary care and attention is given to you. We will definitely come back. I had several meetings, but kept wanting to come back and hang out at the restaurant and bar. Every staff member is extremely conscientious. I showed up dressed like a slob - and they still treated me like a king. We went back to our room late at night and had problems opening the door to our suite. While maintenance took care of the problems they comped our drinks at the restaurant. They obsessed on all the details - and you feel amazing staying in this place. I highly recommend it.

"Just above average" The location is really not advisable, impractical, and even poorly served by public transportation, taxis included.
The hotel is very basic and not especially well maintained.
The rooms match the overall impression of the property itself: basic and clearly improvised, leaving nothing good in the memory of a stay at this place.
Absolutely forgettable, even if you are in Beverly Hills.

"On Pico Blvd, ideal location..." Whether you are heading to Santa Monica, Downtown, Beverly Hills, Hollywood, etc., Mr C.'s location at the corner of Pico and Beverwill Drive is excellent... The hotel, recently renovated under the guidance of the Cipriani family, is comfortable, with bright, spacious rooms and all the desired comforts in the bathrooms... There is a pool with a relaxation area near the restaurant, and a trendy bar where they will serve you a Bellini, the signature drink of the Italian group... A corner of Italian comfort with a cinematic influence, with many rare photos of stars and directors in the hallways and rooms... The staff is excellent in the way they interact with guests (valet service, advice...). The clientele is typical of the neighborhood near Rodeo Drive... and that can be quite a spectacle!
Of course, the prices reflect all this, but you do not come to Beverly every other day... so why not! In any case, it has a very specific atmosphere that feels refreshingly different from U.S. chains. Thanks to Salomon for his kindness in French. We did not dine at the restaurant, so we have no comments on the quality of the food...
